question: Which award was started by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in 1980 to the exponents of Hindustani classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tansen Samman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Tansen Samman is an esteemed award started by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in 1980.

• It is given to the exponents of Hindustani classical music in recognition of their contribution and excellence in the field.

• The award is named after the legendary musician Tansen, who was one of the nine gems in the court of Emperor Akbar.

• The Tansen Samman includes a cash prize and a citation, honoring the recipient's lifelong dedication to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Hindustani Classical Music**

• Hindustani classical music is one of the two major traditions of Indian classical music, the other being Carnatic music.

• It originated in North India and has a rich history that dates back to the Vedic times.

• The music is characterized by its raga (melodic framework) and tala (rhythmic cycle).

• Some of the prominent exponents of Hindustani classical music include Ravi Shankar, Zakir Hussain, and Bhimsen Joshi.

• **Tansen**

• Tansen was a prominent figure in Indian classical music and is often regarded as one of the greatest musicians of all time.

• He was a musician in the court of Emperor Akbar in the 16th century.

• Tansen is known for his contributions to the development of Hindustani classical music, especially the dhrupad style of singing.

• His legacy continues to influence Indian music to this day.

• **Other Notable Awards in Music**

• **Kumar Gandharva Samman:** Named after the famous classical singer Kumar Gandharva, this award is given to young musicians for their contribution to Indian classical music.

• **Kishore Kumar Samman:** This award is given in the field of film music and is named after the legendary playback singer Kishore Kumar.

• **Iqbal Samman:** This award is given for outstanding contribution in the field of Urdu literature and music.
